name: The Classic Counter
blurb: Burgers, fries and shakes, the same everywhere. Easy to train, easy to copy, easy to love.
pitch: Eight items, one fryer, one grill. A new crew can learn it in a week.

name: Sunrise All Day
blurb: Breakfast muffins from the moment you open, wraps at lunch, swirl cones after school.
pitch: Busy mornings pay the rent. Commuters, school runs and office lunches.

name: Garden & Chicken
blurb: No beef, no pork: chicken, fish and veggie buns that travel to any city on the map.
pitch: Fewer recipes to change when you cross a border. Cities with no-beef or no-pork rules welcome it as it is.
